task_title: Floor 2 industrial-cave generated terrain pack + crenellation fix + engine wiring

plan_review.notes: Adversarial rubber-duck review (gpt-5.4). 3 blocking + 5 non-blocking concerns, all confirmed TRUE and addressed. B1 pack doorSet PNGs are not runtime-wired (engine door path resolveDoorRenderMode uses the global tile-door-v1-var-0 texture; the pack resolver resolveDoorPoolVariant is only referenced by gen/lab/tests) -> narrowed scope, documented the doorSet as not-yet-consumed, filed a follow-up issue rather than adding unapproved engine door-wiring. B2 the committed manifest (runtime source of truth via terrain-pack-registry) had zero test coverage because every build test validates the in-memory procedural builder -> added tests/unit/sprites/terrain-pack-committed.test.ts which loads the committed manifest and shipped PNGs from disk. B3 a file mtime is not proof the crenellation fix is in the shipped art -> the committed-pack test asserts the SHIPPED atlas meets the 188/188 (100%) authored edge-compatibility floor, a durable geometry guard. NB4 build CLI contract awkward -> env-guarded the procedural writer (preview-dir alternative rejected to avoid builder/test churn). NB5 BootScene preload wiring ungated -> added a source-assertion guard to boot-scene-generated-sprite-gate.test.ts. NB6 the 99.5 percent metric was a weak proxy -> replaced by the 100 percent committed edge-compat floor plus the real 11509-wall render count. NB7 corridorCount=0 -> documented (the cave seed emits no corridor tiles; corridorPool ships for future seeds). NB8 provenance kind is coarse -> explicit honest derivationNote, now guarded by the committed-pack test. 3 alternatives (preview-output builder, byte-reproducible source compositor, lazy per-floor loading) were enumerated and rejected with grounded reasons; the reviewer concluded no redesign was warranted.

code_review.notes: Round 1: 4 parallel reviewers (claude-sonnet-4.6, gpt-5.3-codex, gemini-3.1-pro-preview code review + an independent security-review pass). gemini + security clean; codex 2 Medium, sonnet 1 Medium = 3 distinct findings, all adjudicated valid and fixed in 27005a947 (1: overwrite-guard truthiness bypass clobbered shipped art; 2: boot-scene preload regex false-passed if the call drifted into create(); 3: committed-pack test comment overstated cardinal-edge sampling as general crenellation proof + had no direct anti-crenellation assertion). Round 2: both re-reviewers (claude-sonnet-4.6, gpt-5.3-codex) confirmed all 3 fixes correct+complete with no new regressions -> clean.

multi_model_review.notes: Adjudicated by claude-opus-4.8. Round 1 spanned 4 reviewers across 3 distinct code-review models plus an independent security-review pass (clean: no secrets, gen/ untracked, 13 PNGs valid, no path traversal/SSRF/injection). The adjudicator classified all 3 findings valid/in-scope and delegated the fixes. Round 2 used 2 distinct models (claude-sonnet-4.6, gpt-5.3-codex), both clean; resolved_count >= valid_count each round; 2-round loop terminated clean (no human escalation needed).
